<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_aleen_snguardian_badge_template">

        <back><svg width="350" height="500" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Badge Base -->
  <rect x="25" y="25" width="280" height="400" rx="15" fill="#B0C4DE" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
 
  <!-- Contact Details -->
  <text x="165" y="170" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" fill="#333" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Contact Info:</text>
  <text x="165" y="200" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#333" text-anchor="middle">${visitor.email}</text>

    Please keep this badge visible at all times.
  </text>
</svg></back>
        <front><svg width="350" height="500" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Badge Base  -->
  <rect x="25" y="25" width="280" height="400" rx="15" fill="#B0C4DE" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Logo Area with More Space -->
<circle cx="170" cy="110" r="50" fill="#fff"/>

<!-- Visitor Photo (Centered within the Circle) -->

<image x="120" y="60" width="100" height="100" href="/sys_attachment.do?sys_id=${visitor.photo}" clip-path="url(#circleMask)" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>

<!-- Clip Path to Ensure Image Stays Circular -->
<defs>
  <clipPath id="circleMask">
    <circle cx="170" cy="110" r="50"/>
  </clipPath>
</defs>

  <!-- Name & Details (Centered Text) -->
 <text x="150" y="190" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" fill="#333" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">${visitor.first_name}</text> 
  <text x="190" y="190" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" fill="#333" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">${visitor.last_name}</text>
  <text x="170" y="270" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" fill="#333" text-anchor="middle">${visitor.company}</text>
   <text x="170" y="310" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" fill="#333" text-anchor="middle">${purpose}</text>

  <!-- Decorative Line -->
  <rect x="100" y="340" width="150" height="2" fill="#333" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg></front>
